h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in Waco with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in Waco?
faqs.a: The court cost is typically up to about $144 ($169 in a school zone), set by each court — some McLennan County courts charge less (McGregor and Moody, for example, post $143.90). The TDLR-approved course is separate; ours is $28. Check your court's page for the exact amount.

faqs.q: Can I take the Waco defensive driving course online?
faqs.a: Yes. Once the court approves your request, a TDLR-approved 6-hour course can be completed fully online. Every Waco-area court accepts a state-approved online course.

faqs.q: My ticket is from Hewitt / Woodway / Robinson / Bellmead, not Waco. Does that change things?
faqs.a: The legal steps are the same, but you deal with that city's court — each with its own fee, request method, and deadlines. Open its page in the table above.

faqs.q: How long do I have to finish?
faqs.a: Generally 90 days after the court approves the request. Request the course by your appearance date first, and don't pay the ticket — paying is a guilty plea and a conviction.

faqs.q: Does a dismissal keep it off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A driving safety course dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record under Texas law, so it can't raise your insurance — unlike paying, which is a conviction.

courts.name: Waco Municipal Court
courts.note: Waco requires the request within 10 calendar days of the citation date and the $144 fee ($169 school zone) paid when you ask — by mail, online, or in person.

courts.name: Bellmead Municipal Court
courts.note: Bellmead (I-35) charges court costs plus a $10 fee — submit a notarized plea form and Type 3A record by your appearance date; 90 days.

courts.name: Beverly Hills Municipal Court
courts.note: Beverly Hills Municipal Court (McLennan County, TX — a small city within Waco, not California) hasn't posted its standard DSC fee online — call (254) 752-2584 ext. 2 by your appearance date to confirm.

courts.name: Bruceville Eddy Municipal Court
courts.note: Got a ticket in Bruceville-Eddy (McLennan County, I-35 south of Waco)? The municipal court charges $144 to dismiss a traffic ticket via Driver Safety Course.

courts.name: Crawford Municipal Court
courts.note: Crawford Municipal Court (McLennan County, west of Waco) charges a $144 court admin fee ($169 in a school zone) to dismiss a ticket via Driver Safety Course — submit your notarized form before your appearance date.

courts.name: Golinda Municipal Court
courts.note: Got a speeding ticket in Golinda (McLennan County, south of Waco)? The Golinda Municipal Court hasn't posted its DSC fee online — call (254) 881-7333 before your appearance date to request dismissal via Driver Safety Course.

courts.name: Hewitt Municipal Court
courts.note: Hewitt (I-35) charges $144 ($169 school zone) by money order — request in person or by mail by your appearance date; 90 days to finish.

courts.note: Lacy Lakeview (I-35) takes a written DSC request by your appearance date — call (254) 799-2458 for the court costs; disposition within 20 business days.
